description: This file defines a controller class for handling custom fields in the account section of an OpenCart project. It processes requests to retrieve custom fields associated with a specific customer group, returning the data as JSON.

classes.name: CustomField
classes.description: Controller class for managing custom fields related to customer accounts, extending the core Controller class in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to handle incoming requests for custom fields; determines customer group ID and returns associated custom fields as JSON.
